Verse API — Quickstart#

Everything Verse does is a plain HTTP API — the playground, the embed SDK, and the Blender, Unity and Unreal exporters are all clients of the same endpoints. Anything that can send an HTTP request (a game-engine plugin, a Blender add-on, a CI pipeline, curl) can turn a 3D file into a signed, streamed share link.

  • Base URL: https://verse.ctruh.com (self-hosted: your origin)
  • Postman collection: /verse-api.postman_collection.json — import and try every call
  • Full reference: docs/api.md · Embed SDK: docs/embed-sdk.md · JS/TS client: docs/sdk.md (@ctruhtech/verse-sdk — not on npm yet; build it from sdk/ or load /sdk/verse-sdk.js)

Authentication#

Two modes, set by the server operator:

  • Open mode (no key file configured — current default): no auth header needed. Uploads are rate-limited to 6/hour per IP (20/hour per account token sent as Authorization: Bearer); publish endpoints (tour/poster/ experience) to 30/hour per IP. Files up to 512 MB, or 2 GB when prepared and sent through the resumable upload; GET /v1/limits returns the live numbers.
  • Keyed mode: send X-Api-Key: <your key> on uploads. Each key has a daily upload quota (default 512 MB/day). Bad or missing key → 401; over quota → 429. Keys are provisioned by the operator in ingest/.verse-keys.json (see docs/api.md).

The core flow: file in → share link out#

1. Upload — POST the raw bytes (no multipart):

Code
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/v1/ingest" \
  -H "Content-Type: model/gltf-binary" \
  -H "X-Verse-Name: my-apartment" \
  --data-binary @scene.glb
# → 202 {"job":"my-apartment-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}

Accepted inputs, auto-detected by magic bytes:

You sendDetected asCompiles to
.glb (binary glTF; Draco + KTX2 supported)mesh scenestreamed .vpk
.ply or .splat (Gaussian-splat capture)splatstreamed .vsp
.ply (points), .las / .laz, .e57, .xyz / .ptspoint cloudstreamed point cloud
.ifc, .usdz / .usd*, .fbx, .obj (alone or zipped with textures), PLY meshconverted to GLB on the serverstreamed .vpk
a phone / LiDAR capture, a 3D tour export bundle's .zipscan (cleaned up first)Fidelity or streamed — see Import a scan

Force the kind for headerless formats with X-Verse-Kind (splat, cloud, ifc, usd, fbx, obj, ply); the full header list (bake, Fidelity path, look, scan, up axis, units) is in POST /v1/ingest. X-Verse-Name is optional (lowercase letters, digits, -, _); it prefixes the id. Max body: 512 MB (20 GB for a prepared GLB through the resumable upload).

2. Poll the job until done (typical: ~8 s per source MB, floor 15 s — the record carries a live stage and estimateS so you can show honest progress):

Code
curl -sS "$BASE/v1/ingest/my-apartment-1a2b3c4d5e6f"
Code
{
  "status": "done",
  "url":    "https://…/?vpk=ingest/my-apartment-1a2b3c4d5e6f.vpk",
  "vpkUrl": "https://…/ingest/my-apartment-1a2b3c4d5e6f.vpk",
  "stats":  { "tris": 182340, "clusters": 3271 },
  "signed": true
}

While compiling you get {"status":"compiling","stage":"…","estimateS":…}; on failure {"status":"error","error":"…","errorInfo":{…}}. Splat jobs return vspUrl and stats: {splats, chunks} instead. signed: true means the artifact carries an Ed25519 signature the browser verifies against /v1/pubkey.

3. Share. url is the ready-to-open walkthrough. Embed it with the SDK (docs/embed-sdk.md) or an iframe. Scenes uploaded with an account token are kept; anonymous ones are kept best-effort and the least-recently-opened are removed when the server's disk budget fills (Retention).

Publishing extras#

EndpointBodyReturns
POST /v1/experienceJSON {scene, …} per experience-format, ≤128 KB{path, url} — a ?experience= link
POST /v1/tourJSON {scene, samples:[[t,x,y,z,fx,fy,fz]×2..6000]}, ≤512 KB{path, url} — a ?tour= link
POST /v1/posterraw PNG, ≤4 MB{path, url} — a poster image URL

Live presence (shared tours)#

  • GET /v1/room/<id>/events — Server-Sent Events roster stream (id = [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}).
  • POST /v1/room/<id>/pose — JSON {id, name, color:"#rrggbb", pose:[x,y,z,fx,fy,fz]} ≤2 KB, ~8 Hz. Peers expire after 10 s of silence; 32 peers per room. Rooms are ephemeral, in-memory, unauthenticated — treat room ids as capability URLs.

Large files: resumable upload#

Above ~100 MB, use the resumable flow so an edge hiccup resumes instead of restarting: POST /v1/ingest/begin {size, name} → {uploadId}, ordered PUT /v1/ingest/part/<uploadId> with Content-Range, then POST /v1/ingest/commit/<uploadId> → the same 202 {job}. An out-of-order part answers 409 with the server's received offset to resume from. Details: Resumable uploads.

Own, protect, review#

  • POST /v1/account {name} → a token (shown once) that owns what you upload with Authorization: Bearer <token>: permanent scenes, /studio, analytics.
  • PATCH /v1/scenes/<id> {"visibility":"private"} + POST /v1/scenes/<id>/share → per-recipient share tokens; ?share=<token> on the link. Guide.
  • POST /v1/review/<id> {pos, text} / GET /v1/review/<id> — comments pinned in 3D on the shared scene. Guide.

Errors#

Every error the app generates is JSON {"error":"…"} with a real status and the header X-Verse-Error: 1: 401 unknown key, 404 unknown job, 409 out-of-order part, 413 body too large, 429 rate/quota, 503 compile queue full, 507 storage full. An error without the header came from the network edge, not the app — that one is worth a retry. Back off on 429/503; re-upload on error. Full rule: Error contract.

Building a plugin (Blender / Unity / Unreal)#

An exporter needs exactly three calls: export the scene to GLB, POST /v1/ingest (or the resumable trio), poll GET /v1/ingest/<job>, then hand the user the url. The shipped integrations are the reference implementations: integrations/blender/verse_publish (Extensions add-on, stdlib-only, verified in Blender 5.0.1), integrations/unity/com.ctruh.verse-publish (UPM package, verified in Unity 6000.6.5f1) and integrations/unreal/VersePublish (editor plugin, verified in Unreal Engine 5.8.3). Each has a README and a how-to guide; the server URL is configurable, so they work against the hosted service or a self-hosted origin identically. Minimal single-file protocol examples remain under tools/verselink-*.
